stop_condition: Any parsed row missing instId tradeId ts px sz or side
go_condition: 100% of parsed rows contain instId tradeId ts px sz and side
measurement_method: Field coverage count by required field divided by parsed rows

stop_condition: OKX side semantics become uncertain or no longer documented as taker/aggressor side
go_condition: Documentation remains available and records side as trade side of taker/aggressor
measurement_method: Record documentation reference or local proof note at execution time
notes: Do not infer taker side from intuition

stop_condition: Any same instId+tradeId has conflicting ts px sz or side
measurement_method: Group by instId+tradeId and compare payload fields

stop_condition: Benign duplicate rate after pagination and retries is >1.0% of raw rows
go_condition: Benign duplicate rate <=1.0% of raw rows
notes: Benign means identical duplicate payloads only

stop_condition: Any unresolved missing or incomplete bucket before advancing
measurement_method: Bucket completeness table with reason codes

stop_condition: Any unexplained cursor gap inside requested time window
go_condition: No unexplained cursor gaps inside requested window
measurement_method: Cursor continuity and timestamp coverage audit
notes: Known endpoint boundary gaps must be explicitly bounded

stop_condition: More than 3 retries needed for a failed request or unresolved request failure inside target window
go_condition: Max 3 retries per failed request and all target-window requests resolved
measurement_method: Request log retry_count and response status

stop_condition: Requests >2500 or runtime >45 minutes or raw archive >500 MB
go_condition: Requests <=2500 runtime <=45 minutes raw archive <=500 MB
measurement_method: Fetch log request count wall-clock runtime raw archive size

stop_condition: Requests >20000 or runtime >6 hours or raw archive >4 GB
go_condition: Requests <=20000 runtime <=6 hours raw archive <=4 GB
measurement_method: Fetch log request count wall-clock runtime raw archive size

stop_condition: Requests >150000 or runtime >36 hours or raw archive >25 GB
go_condition: Requests <=150000 runtime <=36 hours raw archive <=25 GB
measurement_method: Fetch log request count wall-clock runtime raw archive size

stop_condition: Requests >500000 or runtime >5 days or raw archive >75 GB or processed output >10 GB
go_condition: Requests <=500000 runtime <=5 days raw archive <=75 GB processed output <=10 GB
measurement_method: Fetch log request count wall-clock runtime raw and processed sizes

stop_condition: CP4 bucket completeness <100% or projected all-19 30d raw storage >=300 GB or rate-limit risk unacceptable
go_condition: CP4 100% bucket completeness and projected all-19 30d raw storage <300 GB and acceptable rate-limit risk
measurement_method: Projection from CP4 rows requests storage per instrument
notes: Recommendation only; does not authorize all-19 fetch
